title: columnea nummularia
intro: Columnea nummularia, commonly known as the nummularia columnea or goldfish plant, is a type of flowering plant native to Central and South America. This plant is known for its bright green, coin-shaped leaves and vibrant purple flowers. Columnea nummularia has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, supporting the plant's potential health benefits.
